name: Subagent Workflow
description: Wire coding-agent harnesses into a fan-out workflow on a canvas: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode, Aider, Cursor Agent, the built-in Pi runner, or a custom command. Bookend it with start and end nodes, configure each node's harness, model, prompt, working dir and fan-out, then run the whole graph server-side and watch every node stream its output.
author: Pi Scope
